hook: Read a magazine piece on working from home and follow its argument: the trend, the pros, the cons and what comes next.
intro: A magazine text about working from home — the kind of argumentative piece you meet in magazines and on news sites, weighing opinions for and against. It has three paragraphs: the trend and its advantages, the disadvantages, and a forecast. It uses the machinery of argument you need to recognise: weil for reasons, aber and manche … andere for contrast, Experten glauben, dass … for a reported view, and werden for the forecast. The six questions ask how often people work from home, the reasons on each side, the experts’ view and what the office is still for. Read it once for the structure — trend, pro, contra, outlook — then again for the vocabulary of work (Angestellte, Mitarbeiter, Chefs, Besprechungen, flexibel), which you will need in your own writing.
tips[0].title: The shape of an opinion text
tips[0].text: Trend (Immer mehr Menschen …) → advantages (Viele finden das praktisch, weil …) → disadvantages (Aber es gibt auch Nachteile.) → outlook (Experten glauben, dass …). Find the four parts before answering.
tips[0].check.why: Aber es gibt auch … is the classic turn from the advantages to the other side.
tips[0].visual.moves[0].label: The trend
tips[0].visual.moves[1].label: Pros
tips[0].visual.moves[2].label: Cons
tips[0].visual.moves[3].label: Outlook
tips[1].title: Every Warum? has its weil
tips[1].text: The questions about reasons are answered by weil-clauses — three of them in this text. Read to the end of the clause: the verb there often carries the point.
tips[1].check.why: The reason sits in the weil-clause: weil er mehr Sport machen möchte.
tips[2].title: Traps are exaggerations
tips[2].text: Wrong options often turn "the most" into "everyone" and "part of the week" into "always": niemand mehr, fast alle, ganz zu Hause. Check the quantity words: meistens, manche, die meisten, nur wenige.
tips[2].check.why: Manche means 'some', not 'all', and an zwei Tagen pro Woche is part of the week, not ganz zu Hause.
remember[0]: Trend – pro – contra – outlook: the four-part shape.
remember[1]: Warum? → find the weil. Check quantity words before you choose.
exam: Magazine articles weighing pros and cons are a standard reading text in the B1 exam — and in any German newspaper.
tips[0].check.q: 'Aber es gibt auch Probleme: Viele Eltern haben zu Hause wenig Ruhe.' Which part of an opinion text does this line start?
tips[1].check.q: 'Herr Kim fährt mit dem Fahrrad zur Arbeit, weil er mehr Sport machen möchte.' Why does Mr Kim cycle to work?
tips[1].check.options[0]: He wants to do more exercise
tips[1].check.options[2]: It is faster than the bus
tips[1].check.answer: He wants to do more exercise
tips[2].check.q: 'Manche Firmen erlauben Homeoffice an zwei Tagen pro Woche.' Which statement matches?
tips[2].check.options[0]: Some companies allow two days a week at home.
tips[2].check.options[1]: All companies allow working from home.
tips[2].check.options[2]: Some companies let staff work entirely from home.
tips[2].check.answer: Some companies allow two days a week at home.
